answer: New agents receive trust only by surviving a zephyr of small randomized tasks, then a gale of escalating audits paced across epochs. Each agent must stake a bond and pass a unique-identity check split through a prism of independent attestors, so fake accounts cannot cheaply multiply. Fabricating thousands of sybils means paying every bond plus audit costs, while legitimate agents recover stakes; the burn makes mass identity spoofing economically irrational. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
